text:
### Purpose
Real-time fraud detection and transaction risk scoring.
name: Chunk 27/57

raw_entities.name: Real-time Fraud Detection
raw_entities.description: A continuous monitoring system designed to identify and flag potentially fraudulent transactions as they occur. This real-time detection capability enables immediate intervention and risk assessment on customer accounts.
context: Real-time fraud detection and transaction risk scoring

raw_entities.name: Transaction Risk Scoring
raw_entities.description: A quantitative assessment mechanism that evaluates the risk profile of individual transactions based on defined criteria and patterns. This scoring system supports fraud detection and helps prioritize investigation of high-risk activities.
context: Real-time fraud detection and transaction risk scoring
